# Emory Financial – Derek Shao, Independent California Mortgage Broker

> Emory Financial (Financial Dynamics, Inc. DBA Emory Financial) is an independent residential mortgage brokerage in Arcadia, California, founded by Derek Shao (NMLS #242117, CA DRE #01358261; company NMLS #393986). Licensed for 20 years, Derek has placed 1,233 home loans totaling $479M across 192 California cities since 2011. He shops the wholesale market across many lenders for purchase, refinance, cash-out, HELOC, jumbo, FHA, VA, and self-employed / bank-statement loans, with a focus on the San Gabriel Valley, Greater Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, Ventura County and San Diego.

Contact: 310-869-5678 · derekshao@emoryfinancial.com · 444 E Huntington Drive, Suite 207, Arcadia, CA 91006 · Mon–Fri 9am–6pm · https://emoryfinancial.com/contact

## About
- [About Derek Shao](https://emoryfinancial.com/about): Background, 20 years as a licensed California broker, how he works

- [Referral partners](https://emoryfinancial.com/partners): Working with real estate agents, CPAs and estate attorneys

## Loan programs
- [All loan programs](https://emoryfinancial.com/loans): Purchase, refinance, cash-out and HELOC, self-employed and jumbo
- [Purchase loans](https://emoryfinancial.com/loans#purchase): First home, move-up and second homes
- [Refinance](https://emoryfinancial.com/loans#refinance): Rate-and-term, removing mortgage insurance, leaving an adjustable rate
- [Cash-out and HELOC](https://emoryfinancial.com/loans#cashout): Using home equity while keeping a low first-mortgage rate
- [Self-employed and jumbo](https://emoryfinancial.com/loans#specialty): Bank-statement, asset-depletion and loans above the conforming limit

## Tools and answers
- [Mortgage calculators](https://emoryfinancial.com/calculators): Payment (PITI + MI), affordability, refinance and payoff
- [Mortgage FAQ](https://emoryfinancial.com/faq): Broker vs. bank, PMI, self-employed income, co-signing, fees, prepayment penalties
